Definition: a harbor (as shut in by the shore)
BiblicalUsage: Machoz is the haven, the harbour, and it appears once, in Psalms 107:30, where the sailors are glad because the sea is quiet, and God brings them unto their desired haven.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the haven here is the whole point of the psalm: God does not only calm the storm, He brings His people safely in.
